name: week
title: This week: promises and call reviews

sections.title: Commitments due
sections.sql: select title,account,owner,due_on,days_overdue,review_state from commitment_review where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Calls needing review
sections.sql: select title,owner,review_state from meeting_review where review_state<>'Ready' order by title

sections.title: Scored criteria
sections.note: Manual 0 to 5 scores. Only calls currently cleared for use are included. These are not automated performance ratings.
sections.sql: select * from coaching_review order by owner,criterion

sections.title: Record exceptions
sections.note: Operational checks, not certification of recording law compliance.
sections.sql: select title,owner,rule,issue from privacy_exceptions order by rule,title
